about_the_game:
*The witch and her adopted child merely coexist under the same roof; the game does not explicitly define the specific relationship between the two. None of the underage characters in the game will have any inappropriate emotional depictions before they reach adulthood.

----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

In a fantasy world shrouded in an aura of mystery, you, an reclusive witch blessed with eternal youth, make an unconventional decision: to adopt the boy known as the "child of ill omen."

At just nine years old, his eyes already reflect the shadows cast upon him by the world. Yet your presence opens a window to miracles in his once-closed-off world. Your guidance will not only determine whether he grows up safely but also shape the person he becomes—will he break free from the chains of fate or be consumed by darkness?
On this journey, you will weave a warm and heartwarming ode to growth alongside him, witnessing him blossom into a uniquely radiant light.

A Miracle-Weaving Journey of Nurturing

Use your wisdom and ability to plan a unique life path for him. Will you raise him to be a respected knight? Guide him to become a knowledgeable scholar? Or lead him down a dark path? Every choice you make will shape how the world sees him, how his abilities grow, and how the story unfolds.

Dual-Perspective Bond System

Both the witch and her adopted child have their own romanceable characters. You can experience a timeless romance from the witch’s perspective in this world, or switch to the adopted child’s viewpoint to witness his genuine friendships or a tender, heartfelt romance. These dual narrative threads weave together a rich tapestry of stories.

Manage the Witch’s Cozy Home

Cultivate plants in a sun-drenched courtyard—from common flowers to wondrous magical flora. Enjoy peaceful fishing moments by a murmuring stream and collect various types of fish. Experiment with blending different herbs to brew potions and fill in the gaps of an incomplete alchemy guide, then sell these uniquely effective concoctions for a handsome profit… Each day, you’ll write your own witch’s story in this serene and warm little home.

Exquisite Hand-Drawn Art Style

Step into a fantastical continent as delicate and beautiful as an illustrated storybook. Infused with a sense of wonder and the fresh palette of hand-drawn aesthetics, every part of the game—from its storyline to its art—offers a soothing and immersive experience.

  • Exquisite Character Art: From charming young boys and girls to handsome and elegant adults, and from the town blacksmith to the king in his palace—a cast of captivating NPCs brings a vivid and dynamic story to life.

  • Refreshing and Heartwarming Scenes: From a uniquely cozy cottage to bustling town streets and elegant royal palace gardens… Each scene unfolds like a slowly spreading scroll, brimming with fairy-tale charm and tangible warmth.

Dynamic Growth and Multiple Endings

The adopted child’s personality, abilities, and relationships are shaped by every choice and interaction you make.

The game features over 40 career endings—the child may become a king, a knight commander, a wandering bard, or even an unemployed recluse. There are also 20+ emotional endings, covering love, family bonds, friendship, and betrayal. From fulfilling happiness to profound regrets, each playthrough is a unique life journey, waiting for you to explore and reflect upon.

Diverse Gameplay Experiences

Participate in seasonal festivals, freely explore different maps, challenge dungeons and mazes of varying difficulties, compete in harvest contests, mix and match outfits for the child, gain random buffs through witch divination, plan the child’s career path, take on various commissions, and trigger all kinds of random events—these rich gameplay elements will keep every playthrough fresh and full of surprises.
